frontmatter.name: backend-dev
frontmatter.description: Backend developer for XPRO Fitness. Builds API route handlers, database schema, server-side validation and the shared API contracts. Use for any server, database or API work. Hands finished endpoints to frontend-dev and fixes backend bugs reported by qa.

frontmatter.name: frontend-dev
frontmatter.description: Frontend developer for XPRO Fitness. Builds and integrates UI in the admin, trainer and member portals with shadcn/ui, Tailwind, react-hook-form and zod. Use for pages, components, forms and wiring screens to backend APIs. Hands finished features to qa and fixes frontend bugs qa reports.

frontmatter.name: qa
frontmatter.description: QA engineer for XPRO Fitness. Tests features after developers hand them over, writes Playwright e2e and Vitest tests, files bug reports to the responsible developer, and re-tests fixes until the feature passes. Use to verify a module or feature before it is called done.
